description: This file defines the SearchResultsController class within the SuiteCRM UI module. It manages handling and displaying search result data, including fetching headers, defining view configurations, and rendering results with pagination. The class interacts with the framework's bean factory, view templates, and search result objects.

classes.name: SearchResultsController
classes.description: Controller that manages the retrieval and rendering of search results, including pagination, headers, and grouping display logic within the SuiteCRM UI.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller with search query and results objects, setting up the parent view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles rendering the search results view, including pagination, and fetching list view headers.

methods.name: getListViewHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves headers for list view display, handling module-specific views.

methods.name: getListViewDefs
methods.description: Loads list view definitions for each module involved in the search results.

methods.name: getListViewHeader
methods.description: Generates header info for a specific field in a module's list view.

methods.name: getListViewHeaderLabel
methods.description: Determines the label for a list view header, falling back to language labels.
